purpose: Canonical traceability extension for the Brain Observatory frontend/BFF consolidated from the accidental brain-control-plane repository split.
rules: harbourviewcompany-create/Brain is the sole canonical Brain repository.
The Observatory frontend and browser-safe BFF live under apps/observatory.
The split repository source commit remains immutable provenance until retirement parity is proven.
Vercel production rewiring and split-repository retirement remain HOLD until separate parity evidence exists.

code_module_records.schema: typed Observatory read models under apps/observatory/src/types and browser-safe display state
code_module_records.runtime_service: Next.js App Router application under apps/observatory
code_module_records.state_machine: same-origin BFF reads -> typed Observatory model -> deterministic cognitive visualization -> live/quiet/degraded display states
acceptance_criteria: no mock imports in Observatory runtime
desktop/mobile build and structural verification pass
existing production UI behavior is preserved before rewiring
code_module_records.source_preservation: complete split-repo UI source preserved under apps/observatory from immutable source commit
unresolved_gaps: Vercel Git integration still points to the split repository until separately rewired
production parity after rewiring remains HOLD

code_module_records.schema: allowlisted /api/brain path proxy with Vercel OIDC primary identity and server API-key fallback
code_module_records.runtime_service: Next.js route handler and server-only upstream resolver
code_module_records.state_machine: browser same-origin request -> allowlist -> Vercel OIDC/API-key server identity -> Railway Brain API -> no-store response
acceptance_criteria: browser never receives upstream API key
protected upstream paths fail closed without server identity
code_module_records.source_preservation: BFF/OIDC source preserved from the split repository and moved without relaxing authentication
unresolved_gaps: production Vercel project rewiring remains HOLD
post-rewire OIDC subject/audience parity must be verified
